# DiffNotes

> > Technical guides and analysis for AI-powered development tools, with deep focus on Claude Code, MCP servers, and autonomous coding workflows.

DiffNotes provides practical tutorials, configuration guides, and industry analysis for developers using AI coding assistants. Coverage spans Claude Code setup, MCP protocol integration, multi-model workflows, and the evolving landscape of AI-assisted software development.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Anthropic
- AI coding agents
- Autonomous coding workflows
- GitHub Actions integration
- Extended thinking models
- Code review automation
- Multi-model workflows
- Terminal AI agents
- Configuration & settings
- OpenCode
- Developer tools
- Benchmarks (SWE-bench)
- AI development tools
